about: Host registry for route.py (design 4.1). Counts and flags are TAKEN ON TRUST from the 2026-11-17 design table, the utilization feed sample and devices.md; none was re-measured when this file was written. Every flag that changes a rule is spelled out, because route.py refuses a missing one rather than assume it. No addresses, keys or credentials belong in this file: ssh hosts are named by their ssh config alias.

hosts.note: Proxmox host, always on, mostly idle. The router runs here, so jobs placed on it start locally.
VM 102, the 13 CI runners. CI work is placed by runner labels, not by this router, so it takes no router jobs.

R710 #1: backups and restore tests. always_on is false until someone confirms it stays powered (unverified). Its disk is shared with the overlord ingest chain, so a class that reads that disk must wait for it. ssh stays disabled until a key exists.
R620: hosts VM 200, the Postgres standby, so it is always on. ssh stays disabled until a key exists.
VM 200, the Postgres standby on the R620. Measured by the feed, never given router jobs.

Laptop: hub database, the only CUDA card, throttles at about 24 W, was off 6 days in November. A CPU job never goes here while another eligible host is up. No execution route yet (Windows); a CUDA job class needs one first.
Thin client at 82 to 85% RAM: memory-bound, not CPU-bound. Takes no router jobs.
